options.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a single NEW original CropEvidence identity concept called "FIELD APERTURE", in a polished 1536x1024 landscape brand presentation. Attached images are reference for existing website colors and premium editorial character, not website redesign targets. Go beyond generic agriculture leaf logos. Main symbol: a compact rounded square field divided into four asymmetric solid geometric parcels by two gently curving wide negative-space paths; at their intersection a small clean almond-shaped seed appears in negative space. Distinctive, bold, minimal, quietly analytical. NO circular leaf, NO stacked layers, NO CE monogram, NO sprout, NO shield/checkmark. Dark olive #39472C on ivory #F7F4EA, monochrome mark with no gradients. Wordmark exact "CropEvidence", custom-feeling humanist SANS serif with soft optical curves, warm and confident, medium weight, excellent kerning, not a default geometric startup font. Main horizontal lockup large in upper two-thirds. Small heading upper left "FIELD APERTURE". Bottom third show exactly the SAME standalone symbol, SAME symbol and wordmark in ivory on olive background, SAME symbol small on matcha #D5E1BC. Small labels "SYMBOL", "REVERSE", "SMALL SIZE". One concept repeated consistently, generous negative space, flat vector-like crisp edges, no texture, no shadows, no 3D or stationery. No tagline and no numbered option labels. This is a logo exploration, no trademark or certification claims. Do not copy logos from attachments.

Use case: logo-brand. Produce ONE original CropEvidence identity option named "FIELD FOLIO" in a premium 1536x1024 landscape brand board. The attached website references supply ivory, olive, soft pastel color and editorial character only. New distinct symbol: an OPEN BOOK whose two broad curved pages are also a gently rolling agricultural field. Compact, only 5-6 shapes; intelligent agronomic evidence notebook idea, not a literal detailed book illustration. No leaves, no sprout, no stacked diamonds, no C/E monogram, no shield or checkmark. Pair with exact wordmark "CropEvidence" in a finely crafted sturdy transitional serif, softly bracketed serifs, moderate contrast, less thin and fashion-like than Didot, generous x-height, clear premium readability. Use olive #39472C on ivory #F7F4EA. Main horizontal lockup large in upper two-thirds, small tracked top-left label "FIELD FOLIO". Lower third show SAME symbol standalone, SAME complete identity reversed ivory on olive, SAME symbol small on pastel apricot #F3CEAD. Labels "SYMBOL", "REVERSE", "SMALL SIZE". Keep marks geometrically identical at every appearance. Flat crisp vector-style artwork, one-color symbol, ample whitespace. No mockup photography, gradients, paper texture, embossing, 3D or slogans. This is a logo concept board, NOT a webpage. Do not copy source logos. No option numbers.

No gradients, shadows, photos, stationery, 3D, texture, metallic effects, taglines, option numbers or claims of certification. One logo concept repeated, not multiple directions.
